A hotfix for beta.7, out the same day. If Manage Mods showed you a blank page, this is the one.

## The blank Manage Mods page

Opening Manage Mods went blank for anyone with a mod whose mod database listing carries an empty entry among its category tags. Vanilla Variants is the popular case, and three reports arrived on the listing within eleven hours of beta.7, with a fourth on the Discord. The filters added in beta.7 folded case on every tag during the first render, hit the empty entry, and took the whole page down.

Two layers now stand between that data and the page. The mod database reader sanitises every listing at the boundary: category tags and each release's game-version tags are kept only when they are text, release entries are kept only when they are objects, and a release version is always a string. The filter code behind Manage Mods tolerates the same shapes on its own, so a second path to the same crash is closed as well. The regression tests feed the exact malformed JSON the database returns rather than a tidied version of it.

## Also in this build

The main process's renderer defenses (sandbox, node integration, content security policy sources, navigation, window opening and permission handlers) are now pinned by tests that fail the moment any of them is weakened, including a denial that a conditional branch could skip. Tests only, no behaviour change.

## Held for beta.9

Three changes were reviewed and merged today but deliberately kept out of a hotfix: a page-level error boundary so a render crash shows a message and reaches the log instead of blanking the app, a readable compatibility verdict on the mod release list, and a classified login-failure log line that can never carry a credential. They ship next, after a proper test round.

## Known issues

The Windows installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen and some antivirus tools warn on a fresh install. Every build here is produced by GitHub from the public source and you can check any file on VirusTotal before running it.

macOS still has no build.
